entries.definition: of or like a feeble old woman
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Formal-sounding but withering, covering both being a feeble old woman and merely being like one; the scorn is in the word itself.

entries.definition: (of fabrics and paper) grown dark in color over time
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: The only word here about what time does to the colour of cloth or paper, not to a life, and it judges nothing.
examples: the darkened margins of the paper

entries.definition: mentally or physically infirm with age
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Scornful where *aged* is not: weakness of mind or body from age becomes the whole of what it says about the person.
examples: his mother was doddering and frail

entries.definition: mentally or physically infirm with age
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same judgement of weakness from age as *doddering*, but the shorter form makes the mockery sound casual rather than deliberate.

entries.definition: mentally or physically infirm with age
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Informal and blunt - the same weakness from age as *doddering*, in a word too jokey to leave the person any dignity.

entries.definition: (used especially of persons) having lived for a relatively long time or attained a specific age
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Flat and neutral, it covers both a long life lived and simply a stated age reached, where *of age* means only the second.

entries.definition: advanced in years; (‘aged’ is pronounced as two syllables)
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: An *-er* form used as plain description, which makes it the softest word here: it suggests a scale rather than naming a state.

entries.definition: growing old
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Clinical and detached: the same growing old as *aging*, in a style that feels nothing about it.

entries.definition: (of children and animals) young, immature
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: The warmth is in the smallness: calling a child or young animal little makes it lovable, where *small* only measures.
examples: what a big little boy you are
Her little brother was not yet old enough for school.

entries.definition: young and immature
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Youth felt as softness: being not fully grown is something easily broken, not something admired.

entries.definition: expecting a rise in prices
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: A stance, not a judgement: it names an expectation of rising prices, and unlike *optimistic* says nothing about the person holding it.

entries.definition: reflecting optimism
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Puts the optimism in what is shown, not in whoever holds it - it colours a view instead of judging a person's nature.
examples: looked at the world through rose-colored glasses

entries.definition: thrown into a state of disarray or confusion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Names the lost order as a state the thing has been put into and left in, without the damage *broken* implies.

entries.definition: snarled or stalled in complete confusion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Coarse and total - a tangle or dead stop treated as a mess someone made and must answer for; the harshest word here.

entries.definition: snarled or stalled in complete confusion
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The same total tangle or standstill under a short, almost casual label - a sad smile where *fucked-up* is furious.

entries.definition: not efficient or methodical
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The calmest criticism here: it blames missing method and the wasted effort that follows, picturing no wreckage at all.
examples: the project failed through unmethodical planning

entries.definition: thrown into a state of disorganization or incoherence
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Pictures the collapse as a coming-apart: what was holding gives way, and the thing falls into disorder or stops making sense.
examples: price programs became unstuck because little grain was available

entries.definition: radically new or original
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Approval for newness pushed to its edge, where breaking with what came before is everything - a bigger claim than *fresh* makes.

entries.definition: done by hand without mechanical aids or devices
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Purely about method - the hand working without mechanical aid or device - with none of the approval the words beside it carry.

entries.definition: not derivative or imitative
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Praises a thing by what it is not - not taken from a source, not a copy - and, unlike *original*, claims no freshness.

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the fault in being ordinary, not damaged: the thing is found everywhere, where *threadbare* sees it worn thin.
examples: his remarks were trite and commonplace

entries.definition: dull and tiresome but with pretensions of significance or originality
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Heavier and fuller-sounding than *platitudinal*, and the word's own size is part of the mockery: dullness dressed up, then shown up.

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Puts the wear down to time, not to any user - unlike *hackneyed*, which blames someone for running the thing into the ground.

entries.definition: repeated too often; overfamiliar through overuse
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Faults the thing for mileage, not damage: used so often nothing in it can still surprise, milder than the ruin *threadbare* finds.

entries.definition: with no effort to conceal
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: Accusing where *bald* is only blunt: not trying to hide it shows nerve, something they should have been ashamed to show.

entries.definition: plain to see
entries.label: neutral
entries.tone: Mentions disguise only to deny it, suggesting that what is plain to see could have been hidden and was not.

entries.definition: causing physical or psychological pain
entries.label: negative
entries.tone: The plain word: it says something hurts, in the body or the mind, without saying how sharply or how much.

entries.definition: showing patient and unruffled self-control and restraint under adversity; slow to retaliate or express resentment
entries.label: positive
entries.tone: Patience when provoked, in the most formal word for it.
examples: was longanimous in the face of suffering
